description: This file defines the PortGuardian actor class that manages network port monitoring, process detection, recording, and cleanup for an application. It includes functionality for enumerating listening processes, checking port status, recording port/process information, and generating reports on port usage, primarily used for security or resource management within the application's context.

classes.name: PortGuardian
classes.description: An actor class responsible for monitoring, managing, and reporting on network ports and associated processes.

classes.name: PortReport
classes.description: Structure representing a report about the status of a specific port, including expected status and listeners.

methods.name: sweep
methods.description: Asynchronously scans predefined ports, evaluates their listeners, and terminates unexpected or unwanted processes based on the current connection mode.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records information about a process listening on a specific port.

methods.name: removeRecord
methods.description: Removes the record of a process identified by its PID.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Provides a descriptor for the process listening on a given port.

methods.name: diagnose
methods.description: Generates a list of port reports indicating their current status and potential issues.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealth
methods.description: Checks the health of the gateway service on a given port.

methods.name: isListening
methods.description: Checks if a specific port (optionally with a specific PID) is being listened to.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Retrieves a list of listeners on a given port via `lsof`.
